label: prf:degree-one-braid-trivial-volume
title: Proof of degree one braid trivial volume
html:
Proof. Proof of degree one braid trivial volume

Proof. The Markov trace (Jones--Markov trace) is \mathbb{C}-linear, and the volume map \mathrm{Vol} on link diagrams used in \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} vanishes on every diagram whose closure is the unknot, the unlink, or any non-hyperbolic knot. We treat the two summands separately.

  1. Identity term. \overline{1} = (n-component unlink), which is non-hyperbolic. Hence \mathrm{Vol}(\overline{1}) = 0 (Kashaev--Murakami--Murakami convention; the right-hand side of the volume conjecture vanishes on non-hyperbolic links by definition).

  2. Generator terms. Each \sigma_i is a single positive crossing; its closure \overline{\sigma_i} is the unknot together with n-2 disjoint unknotted strands (an (n-1)-component unlink). It is non-hyperbolic, so \mathrm{Vol}(\overline{\sigma_i}) = 0.

  3. Linearity. The trace and volume map are linear on the Hecke algebra, so

      \mathrm{Vol}(\overline{\gamma})
  \;=\;
  \mathrm{Vol}(\overline{1})
  \;+\;
  \sum_{i=1}^{n-1} \phi_i\,\mathrm{Vol}(\overline{\sigma_i})
  \;=\;
  0.

This proves the claim. \blacksquare

Scope. The lemma establishes only the archimedean shadow — the real-valued volume image. It does not identify \gamma with the gauge boson of any physical theory; that identification is interpretive and is discussed in breit-wheeler-vertex and the photon-energy section of the manuscript.

Exclusion. Any candidate algebraic photon constructed as a degree-one element of the Hecke algebra is automatically volume-trivial, hence cannot acquire mass through the \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}\circ\mathrm{Vol}_q pipeline. Mass generation requires a closure that is genuinely hyperbolic, which forces the braid word to have degree \geq 2 in the generators \sigma_i,\sigma_i^{-1}.

Relation to higher-degree contributions. When the photon couples to a massive state \beta_m, the product \gamma \cdot \beta_m shifts in the degree-lex filtration by +1 but otherwise transforms representation content through the Pieri rule (Pieri photon shift). The lemma here is the base case of that ladder.
